Costs and Aid
Applying to George Mason is the first step in your journey to heal and repair the world, no matter your course of study.
At George Mason, we believe that to solve grand challenges, it takes all of us. Together. That means embracing a diversity of identities, origins, circumstances, and perspectives. But it also means the world needs talented, gritty, passionate people working together in the arts, science, humanities, and technology.
With 132 master’s and doctoral degree programs, as well as more than 100 graduate-level certificates, you’ll find a path that is true to yourself and that leads to joining the next generation of fearless leaders.
Before you begin an application, it is important that you consider which program is the best fit for your educational and career goals. Additionally, our graduate programs may have different applications, deadlines, and requirements.
Find Your Graduate Program's Application
Application Fees
Applicants to our graduate programs pay a non-refundable $75 application fee.
Waivers for Those Affected by Regional Workforce Changes
Several colleges are providing application fee waivers for fall 2025 to federal government, government contractor, and organization employees affected by recent changes in the regional workforce. A full list of these colleges and additional details are available in the graduate section of our application fee waiver page.
Antonin Scalia Law School
The Scalia Law School offers six JD programs, a JM program, joint degrees in both business and public policy, and six LLM programs offering both in-person and online options.
